3Presentation · Grammar≈ 20 min

because, so and to

First, listen to Mac talk about a memorable journey. Just relax and listen — what was the best part for him?

Listening · Mac's journey (8.3)
🎧 Mac talks about a journey
0:00 / 0:00

Listen again. Which is true? Choose, then tell your teacher why:

  • 1They went to the river to take a walk / go fishing.
  • 2They slept in the car because the hotel was full / they didn't want to walk anywhere.
  • 3The car wasn't comfortable, so Mac didn't sleep / went for a walk.
because
the cause · why
I don't cycle because I don't have a bike.
to
the purpose · what for
I got up early to finish my homework.
so
the result · what happened
The shops were open late, so we went into town.

Quick rule: because + a reason (subject + verb) · to + verb (the basic form) · so + a result (subject + verb).

Pronunciation · listen & repeat (8.4)
🎧 Notice the sounds in because, so and to
0:00 / 0:00

Listen and repeat. Notice that because /bɪˈkɒz/, so /səʊ/ and to /tə/ are usually said quickly and softly.

Think about it (talk with your teacher)
  • ◆
    "I stayed home because I was ill." — Which part tells us the reason?
  • ◆
    "I went out to buy milk." — Does this tell us the purpose or the result?
  • ◆
    "It was raining so we stayed in." — What happened first?
  • ◆
    After to, do we use buy or buying?
  • ◆
    Which word shows a cause? Which shows a result? Which shows a purpose?

5Production · Speaking≈ 20 min

Now you talk

Use because, so and to as much as you can.

Task 1 · Finish my sentence (6 min)

Read the beginning aloud and finish it in your own words.

“I always check the timetable before a journey, so…”
because …so …to …
03:00
Task 2 · A memorable journey (12 min)

Prepare. Think about a real or imagined journey. Use these questions to make notes:

  • 1Where, when and why did you go on this journey?
  • 2Who did you go with?
  • 3How did you travel? (Use the new words!)
  • 4What happened on the journey?
  • 5Did you see anything interesting?
  • 6How did the journey make you feel, and why?

Speak. Tell your teacher the story. Your teacher will ask questions, like "Why did you go there?" and "So what did you do next?"

03:00
Task 3 · At the station (optional)

Imagine you are at a station or bus stop. Ask your teacher for help using the new words: "Which platform does the train leave from?" · "Where's the ticket machine?" · "Is there a timetable?"

6Wrap-up≈ 4 min

Well done! Safe travels ✦

Before you go

Say one sentence about a journey with each word: one with because, one with so, one with to.

Finish it: "Today I learned…"
